metaDescription: Siamese vaccine schedule with core ages in weeks. Set reminders so Siamese boosters are not missed.

bodySections.heading: Why timing matters for this schedule
paragraphs: Plan Siamese social milestones around the schedule rows, not the other way around, because the 16-week finish is the usual green light clinics cite for broader Siamese exposure.
Weight range 8-14 lb (3.5-6.5 kg) and grooming needs (Short coat; weekly wipe.) belong in the same Siamese household ops list as vaccine dates when busy weeks collide.
If your Siamese is also monitored for amyloidosis risk, ask whether bloodwork or orthopedic checks can share a visit with a booster to cut missed Siamese appointments.
After the Siamese puppy/kitten series, keep adult FVRCP and rabies renewals on 7/3/1-day reminders so year-two surprises disappear.

bodySections.heading: If a dose is missed or delayed
paragraphs: Owners postpone Siamese shots when the kitten seems “a little off,” travel intervenes, or dental disease worries dominate the week — ask the clinic whether a same-week Siamese make-up is still appropriate instead of sliding to the annual exam.
Long gaps can leave Siamese antibody levels uncertain, so expect either an added booster or a titer conversation rather than a shrug.
Do not trade the missed Siamese dose for extra socialization; finish immunity first for this medium cat.
Reset the Siamese reminder stack the evening of the make-up appointment — including the eventual adult booster after the 16-week finish.

faqs.question: When does the Siamese core vaccine series usually finish?
faqs.answer: This breed record completes core vaccines around 16 weeks of age, with rabies timed per local law. Your clinic may adjust intervals for the individual kitten.

faqs.question: What should I do if my Siamese misses a booster?
faqs.answer: Contact your veterinarian for a catch-up plan instead of restarting or skipping ahead. Keep prior dates handy and limit high-risk exposure until the series is current again.

faqs.question: Where can I read Siamese health context beyond vaccines?
faqs.answer: See the Siamese adult health guide for breed predispositions such as dental disease, then bring those notes to wellness and vaccine visits.
